The background shows historic stone buildings with balconies and small trees under a bright sky. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor cafe environment. A close-up shot shows a large, round Basque cheesecake being sliced with a knife, revealing a creamy center. Another shot shows hot water being poured over coffee grounds in a drip filter. (3) Back on the street, the man is seen holding a paper coffee cup, taking sips and reacting with expressive facial expressions (raised eyebrows and nodding). He holds a white bag of coffee beans in front of his chest. (4) The man opens a white cardboard box containing two large slices of cheesecake. He uses a white plastic spoon to take bites, closing his eyes to savor the taste. He smiles broadly and continues talking excitedly while holding the spoon.
